item: The Wikidata fetch button names the kill switch by our own sentence, not by a phrase inside another failure (R298's anchoring on the JS side)
refs: PR pending; R298; found by the read of PR #1546
summary: entitySpineFetch toasted Refused: airplane mode is on for any error whose message contained the words anywhere (/airplane mode/i), so a 502 that echoed a remote page or a redirect text quoting them read as the person's own setting. A new helper _wikidataRefusedByAirplaneMode takes a 409 (the route's one refusal) or a message that STARTS with our sentence (network refused: airplane mode is engaged, or the socket guard's airplane mode is engaged: ...); every other failure keeps its own text. Driven as real code in a node test (extracted from the shipped module) with the spoof controls; two mutants killed (the old regex restored; the 409 branch dropped). No new string.
